newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 falls led by SPT Telecom.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 falls led by SPT Telecom.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index moved lower on Friday with the most heavily capitalised share, SPT Telecom sliding 69 crowns, 1.6 percent, to 4,260 while Ceske Radiokomunikace continued to post strong gains.
Dealers say SPT, which accounts for 20 percent of the PX50's total capitalisation, may have risen too far in recent sessions and that a small correction was to have been expected.
"I think there will be some profit taking now after the highs but I don't expect it to drop below 4,000," said Vaclav Verner a telecommunications analyst at Zivnostenska Banka.
Radiokomunikace rose another 132 crowns to 4,532. Since TeleDanmark announced on Tuesday that it had taken a 21 percent stake in the company, Radiokomunikace has risen 412 points or 10 percent.
Verner said there was a limit to how long Radiokomunikace could retain the market's attention because there were now so few shares left on the open market.
Overall, activity was relatively heavy with turnover just failing to hit the one billion crown mark and volume at 663,938 shares traded.
